title: The Literal Clause
summary: Contract-factors and reef-wardens operating around the Coral Tower of Thras, the Sunken Throne, and the Sload Spawning Pools stop an unsentimental Sload cabal cultivating a plague-vat under a trade loophole.

hook.rumour: Factor-clerks at the Sload Spawning Pools discovered that a delivery of alchemical brine to the Thrassian Plague Pits and Coral Tower of Thras matches the old Second Era crimson-vat formula.
hook.notice: ATOLL EXCHANGE OF THRAS: Contract-enforcers needed to inspect the Thrassian Plague Pits and Coral Tower of Thras under Clause Seven of the Reef Truce.

npcs.name: Warden of Sload Spawning Pools
npcs.greet: Factor-clerks at the Sload Spawning Pools discovered that a delivery of alchemical brine to the Thrassian Plague Pits and Coral Tower of Thras matches the old Second Era crimson-vat formula.
talk: The trouble across the Coral Kingdom of Thras began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Sload Spawning Pools.
If you mean to help the Coral Atoll Factors, start by checking the trail between Sload Spawning Pools and Coral Tower of Thras.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Sload Spawning Pools
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Coral Tower of Thras is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Coral Tower of Thras toward The Sunken Throne before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Sload Spawning Pools so Contract-Factor K'Thul can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of The Sunken Throne
npcs.greet: You made good time from Coral Tower of Thras. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near Thrassian Plague Pits.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at Thrassian Plague Pits with a picked guard.
Once Thrassian Plague Pits is cleared, return to Sload Spawning Pools to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Sload Spawning Pools
npcs.greet: Contract-Factor K'Thul awaits word on whether the crisis in the Coral Kingdom of Thras has been contained.
talk: The elders of Sload Spawning Pools have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of the Coral Kingdom of Thras owes you a debt for standing between Sload Spawning Pools and ruin.
